name: Packaging terms and conditions code
description: Code specifying the packaging terms and conditions.

values.name: Packaging cost paid by supplier
values.description: Packaging cost paid by supplier The cost of packaging is paid by the supplier.

values.name: Packaging cost paid by recipient
values.description: Packaging cost paid by recipient The cost of packaging is paid by the recipient.

values.name: Packaging cost not charged (returnable)
values.description: Packaging cost not charged (returnable) There is no charge for packaging because it is returnable.

values.name: Buyer's
values.description: Buyer's The packaging terms and conditions are specified by the buyer.

values.name: Carrier's durable
values.description: Carrier's durable Reusable packaging owned by the carrier.

values.name: Carrier's expendable
values.description: Carrier's expendable Disposable packaging supplied by the carrier.

values.name: Seller's durable
values.description: Seller's durable Reusable packaging owned by the seller.

values.name: Seller's expendable
values.description: Seller's expendable Disposable packaging supplied by the seller.

values.name: Special purpose buyer's durable
values.description: Special purpose buyer's durable Reusable packaging specifically designed for packaging of the referenced item and owned by the buyer.

values.name: Special purpose buyer's expendable
values.description: Special purpose buyer's expendable Disposable packaging specifically designed for packaging of the referenced item.

values.name: Multiple usage buyer's durable
values.description: Multiple usage buyer's durable Reusable multi-purpose packaging owned by the buyer.

values.name: Multiple usage seller's durable
values.description: Multiple usage seller's durable Reusable multi-purpose packaging owned by the seller.

values.name: Not packed
values.description: Not packed The referenced item is to be supplied without packaging.

values.name: Special purpose seller's durable
values.description: Special purpose seller's durable Non-standard reusable packaging owned by the seller.

values.name: Export quality
values.description: Export quality The packaging used must meet durability and handling characteristics required for item export.

values.name: Domestic quality
values.description: Domestic quality The packaging used must meet durability and handling characteristics required for domestic usage.

values.name: Packaging included in price
values.description: Packaging included in price The cost of packaging is included in the item price.

values.name: Packaging costs split
values.description: Packaging costs split The cost of packaging is shared equally between the buyer and seller.

values.name: Packaging costs invoiced separately
values.description: Packaging costs invoiced separately The packaging cost will be invoiced on a separate message or document.

values.name: Nil packaging costs
values.description: Nil packaging costs The packaging is free of charge.

values.name: Nil packaging costs if packaging returned
values.description: Nil packaging costs if packaging returned The costs of packaging is reimbursed by the seller to buyer if packaging is returned.

values.name: Return chargeable
values.description: Return chargeable The return of packaging/empties is chargeable.

values.name: Chargeable, two thirds of paid amount with credit note on
values.description: Chargeable, two thirds of paid amount with credit note on return of loaned package The buyer receives two thirds of paid amount with credit note if loaned package is returned.

values.name: Rented
values.description: Rented The package has been, or will be, rented.

values.name: Safe return deposit
values.description: Safe return deposit A deposit paid to guarantee the safe return of the package.

values.name: Not reusable
values.description: Not reusable The package is not reusable.

values.name: Package exchangeable at the point of delivery
values.description: Package exchangeable at the point of delivery The package may be exchanged at the point of delivery.

values.name: Tamper evident package
values.description: Tamper evident package The package should give easy or immediate recognition that the package has been tampered with after it has been sealed.

values.name: Labeled
values.description: Labeled The package is labeled.

values.name: Package not marked returnable
values.description: Package not marked returnable The package is not marked returnable.
